channel.title: HiRISE: High Resolution Imaging Science Experiment (NASA)
channel.description: Updates from the HiRISE camera onboard the Mars Reconnaissance Orbiter (MRO/NASA). We are based at the University of Arizona in Tucson, Ariz.

item.title: HiPOD: Ancient Layers Exposed by a Crater within a Crater
item.description: A blanket of dust covers much of the ancient bedrock in these Martian middle latitudes, but impacts can expose buried materials in the resulting steep crater walls. (NASA/JPL-Caltech/University of Arizona)
